source: Turbo Editor Toolbox Owner's Handbook (1985), references outside printed Procedures and Functions Index (pp. 243-244). Printed handbook page numbers.
auditPolicy: Separate historically named helpers, required extension hooks and demonstration/example routines from the indexed 123; no assertion of exhaustive symbol extraction or source-level parity.

entries.name: EditCtrlChar
entries.note: Second control-character decoding for prefixed commands; modern normalized two-step input replaces direct console logic.

entries.name: EditCuradr
entries.note: Command-row cursor positioning helper mentioned in a See Also reference; original signature is not established here.

entries.name: EditFileSave
entries.note: Named in chapter 12's file-operation overview outside the printed index; SaveFile provides the modern operation. Direct historical helper parity is not claimed.

entries.name: EditFileerror
entries.note: DOS file error flag/query is replaced by typed I/O exceptions and semantic error reporting.

entries.name: EditGetinput
entries.note: Editor typeahead dequeue; linked from EditPushtbf and global Circout description.

entries.name: EditInsbuf
entries.note: Logical line insertion helper used by the sample file reader. Modern text buffer and topology service replace pointer allocation.

entries.name: EditKeypressed
entries.note: Check physical keyboard availability and transfer input into editor typeahead; immediate Ctrl-U semantics live at the host boundary.

entries.name: EditMessage
entries.note: Historical lookup from EDITERR.MSG is not reproduced; typed errors and host resources replace the lookup. A replaceable message file is a deliberate divergence.

entries.name: EditScanpat
entries.note: Line-by-line pattern search used by EditFind; modern search service is functionally equivalent in its specified literal forward scan.

entries.name: EditSizeline
entries.note: Reallocate/shrink Pascal line text storage; managed variable-length strings avoid manual buffer sizing.

entries.name: EditWrline
entries.note: Historically compares an image row and its color before physical display; console host safely projects and repaints rows rather than copying video memory.

entries.name: UserCommand
entries.note: Command filtering is exposed via FilterCommand, with typed semantic commands instead of byte mutation.

entries.name: UserError
entries.note: Error handling hook provided as OnErrorAsync with semantic error identity.

entries.name: UserStatusline
entries.note: Per-window status transformation exposed as TransformStatus.

entries.name: UserReplace
entries.note: Replace confirmation exposed as BeforeReplaceAsync.

entries.name: UserTask
entries.note: Cooperative idle/background task extension point, without claiming any particular sample task.

entries.name: DupLine
entries.note: Example composite operation in chapter 12 built from Begin/End/Copy/Hide; not a separately specified toolbox primitive.

entries.name: MakeWindow
entries.note: Modern console popup rectangle and renderer stand in for MicroStar MakeWindow. Tests cover layout, focus and nested overlay lifetime; original DOS screen-cell save and exact historical user interaction are not reproduced or signed off.

entries.name: RestoreWindow
entries.note: Host reconstructs the editor and surviving parent overlays instead of restoring saved DOS video-memory cells. Stack, selection and redraw tests exist; real-terminal interaction and exact historical parity remain open.

entries.name: PrintNext
entries.note: Cooperative scheduler executes at most one snapshot print record per idle slice, with cancellation, failure and file-sink tests. Original PrintNext scheduling, DOS printer control bytes and hardware printing are not claimed.
